key_insight: BioLT extends window-level biosignal models to long, interrupted streams by tracking time gaps and compressing prior context into a fixed-size memory.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support continuous ECG, PPG, and EEG analysis for arrhythmia, sepsis, and seizure detection and forecasting up to 20 minutes ahead.
method: Wraps window-level feature extractors or pretrained biosignal models in a streaming decoder-only framework.
Encodes elapsed time between windows to account for signal interruptions.
Uses a compressed memory bank supervised by cumulative summary statistics, keeping computation linear in recording length.
evidence_signal: Across CPSC-2021, VitalDB, MC-MED, and CHB-MIT, BioLT achieved the highest detection AUROC in 15 of 21 dataset-feature settings and the highest 20-minute forecasting AUROC in 13.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish prospective clinical utility, real-world alert burden, or deployment reliability.
